messages:
maria: heads-up — a mid-market fintech just asked to bundle Private (VPC) + Dedicated throughput + KMS/HSM + audit exports as a single purchasable product. asking for SLA (99.9) and onboarding in ~6 weeks. cc @sam @elaine @jon

sam: can we map this to an existing tier or is it a new sku? sales says they want a per-tenant "compliance" add-on and fixed monthly price, not just pure usage.

elaine: customer is regulated payment processor. key asks: per-tenant encryption (customer keys), audit log exports, region-locking, guaranteed throughput lanes for peak hours. timeline: wants pilot in 6w.

jon: eng reality check — managed KMS (cloud KMS) + audit export: doable in ~3w for Private control plane (light integration). HSM / customer-owned HSM attestation + key wrapping is 8–10w. Throughput isolation: either dedicated GPU pools per-tenant (expensive) or QoS scheduling on shared pools (complex, some risk).

maria: so tradeoffs: 1) Managed-KMS + dedicated QoS path = faster launch, lower isolation. 2) HSM + dedicated pools = full compliance but much longer and pricier. Launch criteria we require: docs + onboarding runbook, security review signoff, billing SKU, automated smoke tests, and rollback plan.

sam: pricing ask from sales: propose a new "Private Pro + Compliance" SKU: base reserved capacity price + add-on $X/mo per-tenant. Need baseline unit economics. also recommend min commitment (3mo) or reserved commit to lock margin.

ben: quick finance sketch: if we require dedicated pools the cost doubles; to hit 15% margin add-on price needs to be ~2.2x reserved delta. If we go managed-KMS + QoS, add-on can be ~1.1x. I can produce model numbers by Thu.

legal-bot: legal note — must include data residency, export control check, and "customer-managed keys" clause variants. SOC2 scope and audit access language needed for full compliance pack. I'll draft clause options (customer-managed KMS vs. Redwood-managed with attestations).

jon: operational note: monitoring and per-tenant telemetry required for SLA. also token-level cost visibility and per-route throttles. Ops change: onboard runbooks and chaos/failure tests for fallback to hosted models.

jen: ops can add per-tenant latency SLO dashboards and cost alerts; ETA ~2w if we get the metric events in the control plane now.

elaine: short-term workaround idea: offer "hosted + private peering" as a stopgap for isolation while we build HSM path. that sacrifices full key ownership but might meet the customer's pilot needs. would sales accept that for a time-limited pilot?

jon: hosted+peering reduces engineering scope ~50% (no full private control plane changes), but no HSM. Good stopgap if customer signs pilot with explicit limitations.

maria: Action list — 1) Eng to produce a short tech options doc with two paths (managed-KMS + QoS vs. HSM + dedicated pools) by Fri, 2) Finance to deliver pricing model and commit thresholds by Thu, 3) Legal to draft contract addenda and key clauses by Fri, 4) Product to define acceptance tests and launch checklist (smoke tests, rollout plan, canary, metrics). If any blocker ping asap.

sam: assigning owners: @jon = eng lead, @ben = finance, @legal-bot = legal, @maria = product. I'll schedule a sync Tue 10am. Need "must-have" launch checklist items in the doc: rollback plan, canary thresholds, monitoring dashboards, billing SKU + usage sample.

elaine: I'll push customer to accept pilot constraints (hosted+peering) as a fast path and capture acceptance of longer HSM timeline in contract.

ben: noted. if pilot accepted, model will include pilot discount and conversion clause to full price on commit.

maria: thanks all. if anyone can't meet Fri, say so here. otherwise I'll consolidate proposals into a single spec ahead of Tue sync.

jon: one more — runtime compatibility: some open models behave differently under quantized runtimes; compliance pack must include validated model version matrix for supported models. we'll add that to tech doc.

elaine: perfect — i'll make sure sales talk track includes the model support caveat and pilot scope.

maria: OK closing thread for now. I'll post the combined spec draft in #product by Mon EOD. :white_check_mark:
